entries.notes: SEC = sqrt(sum((e_i - bias)^2) / (n - A - 1)), denominator n - A - 1 (metrics-and-validation.md §5). Neither scikit-learn nor chemotools computes it, and R mdatools reports RMSE and bias rather than the bias-corrected standard errors, so there is no independent implementation available here to compare against. Checked instead against the identity §5 states - RMSEP^2 = bias^2 + (n-1)/n * SEP^2 - and against hand arithmetic on a six-sample case, both in tests/test_validation.py. This is the same standing SNV and MSC had before #13, recorded as a gap rather than filled with a plausible number.
